critical_correction.correct_diagnosis: BALANCE_EXHAUSTED (67200005) + original PARAMETER_ERROR (68300004) was a schema bug on my part
critical_correction.explanation: V3.1 used wrong request schema ({q:{expression:...}}) for nested-search and current-search endpoints. This produced error 68300004 (Invalid parameter), which I incorrectly classified as 'TIER_RESTRICTED'. After fetching the OpenAPI spec from https://open.patsnap.com/openapi.json, I found the correct schemas: P005 uses {assignee:...,limit:...,offset:...}, P075 uses {query_text:'TTL:...',limit:...,offset:...}. With correct schemas, endpoints return 67200005 (Insufficient balance) — a BALANCE_EXHAUSTED condition, not a tier restriction. The CEO was right to reject the TIER_RESTRICTED diagnosis.
